description: Ten questions that check real understanding of Indonesia. Answers included so you can self-test.
key_points: Q: What is the capital of Indonesia? A: Jakarta
Q: What currency does Indonesia use? A: Rupiah

demo.program:
# Indonesia — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is the capital of Indonesia?", "Jakarta"),
    ("What currency does Indonesia use?", "Rupiah"),
    ("What is capital?", "Jakarta"),
    ("What is currency?", "Rupiah (IDR)"),
    ("What is calling code?", "+62"),
    ("What is internet domain?", ".id"),
    ("What is driving side?", "left"),
    ("What is continent?", "Asia"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
